pages.en: Max is in the garden. He sees a small green frog near the water. The frog jumps. Max jumps too!
pages.zh: Max 在花园里。它看到水边有一只绿色的小青蛙。青蛙一跳，Max 也跟着跳！
pages.scene: Max jumping playfully next to a small green frog by a garden pond, both in the air.

pages.en: A butterfly flies over the flowers, and a bee is on a pink flower. Max wants to play, but the bee is busy.
pages.zh: 一只蝴蝶飞过花丛，一只蜜蜂停在粉红色的花上。Max 想玩，可是蜜蜂正忙着呢。
pages.scene: Max looking up at a colourful butterfly flying over garden flowers, a bee busy on a pink flower.

pages.en: Then the frog jumps into the water, and Max jumps in after it. Now Max is very wet! Lily laughs and gives him a big towel.
pages.zh: 接着青蛙跳进了水里，Max 也跟着跳了进去。现在 Max 浑身湿透了！Lily 笑着给它一条大毛巾。
pages.scene: Lily laughing and wrapping a soaking wet Max in a big striped towel next to the garden pond, the frog on a lily pad.

questions.q: Max is dry at the end of the story.
questions.zh: 故事结尾时 Max 是干的。
